args.sql:
SELECT 
    v.vendregistry AS vendor_registry,
    v.vendchecklvl AS verification_tier,
    v.vendlastmoment AS last_activity_date,
    m.market_status_reputation->>'trust_level' AS vendor_trust_index
FROM 
    Vendors v
JOIN 
    Markets m ON v.mktref = m.mktregistry
WHERE 
    m.market_status_reputation->>'trust_level' = 'High'
ORDER BY 
    v.vendchecklvl, v.vendlastmoment;

SELECT 
    v.vendregistry AS vendor_registry,
    v.vendchecklvl AS verification_tier,
    v.vendlastmoment AS last_activity_date,
    m.market_status_reputation->>'trust_level' AS vendor_trust_index
FROM 
    Vendors v
JOIN 
    Markets m ON v.mktref = m.mktregistry
WHERE 
    m.market_status_reputation->>'trust_level' = 'High'
ORDER BY 
    v.vendchecklvl, v.vendlastmoment;
